create.name: Machiel Klerk
create.bio:
Machiel Klerk is a dream worker, author and poet who has studied dreams and the deeper psyche for some thirty years. Born in South Africa and raised in the Netherlands, he lost his father suddenly at ten, and the grief that went unspoken resurfaced in his twenties as a long inner descent. Carl Jung's writing gave him a way through it, opening a relationship with death and with his ancestors, and his dreams became the guide he has relied on ever since. Alongside Jungian psychology, his work draws on embodiment, non-dual understanding, African Indigenous healing and the dream practices of many cultures.

His book Dream Guidance, published by Hay House, teaches dream incubation: framing a clear question before sleep and learning to work with the dream that answers it, a practice he traces back to ancient Greek temples and Indigenous traditions. He offers an eight-session dream incubation journey for people facing a creative project, a vocational crossroads or a big decision, and he lectures and leads workshops on dreams and non-duality at places such as Esalen, Tibet House US and Menla. He founded the Jung Platform, through which he teaches online, and he works from Manhattan and online.

books.title: Dream Guidance: Connecting to the Soul Through Dream Incubation
books.author: Machiel Klerk
books.description: A practical guide to dream incubation, the old practice of taking a question into sleep and working with the dream that comes in reply. It covers choosing the question, preparing for the night, reading the dream and carrying its guidance into waking life.

courses.title: Dream Incubation Intensive
courses.description: An eight-session one-to-one journey, in Manhattan or online, built around a single question, problem or creative challenge. Together you incubate the question and follow what dreams, synchronicities and images bring in response.
